title: Change in invoice payment deadline date calculation for RPS PODs

storage.value:
User story

As a Billing Specialist,

I want the billing run to calculate a different due date for PODs with the RPS parameter,

So that invoices for those PODs have the correct due date according to RPS requirements, while all other PODs continue to use the standard due date calculation.

Story description

OPS - RPS

Acceptance criteria:

  1. If an invoice includes at least one POD with RPS and the invoice due date is set to “According to contract” the due date should be calculated based on the RPS nomenclature date

    1. The due date should be calculated from the invoice date.

      1. For example, if the nomenclature indicates 5, and the invoice date is 7 May, the due date will be 5 June

      2. The system should use the default calendar to determine working and non-working days.

        1. If the calculated due date falls on a non-working day, it will be adjusted to the nearest working day.

        2. If there is no default calendar, return error on specific invoice

          1. error message: “Billing run cannot be started. The run includes PODs with RPS, and a default calendar is required to calculate invoice payment deadlines for these PODs”

    2. if for one invoice there are two different RPS numbers linked, billing run should return error:

      1. If a contract has two PODs, both with RPS and different RPS numbers, and they belong to the same billing group and are included in the same invoice, the billing run should return an error - error is returned on specific invoice, not whole billing

        1. Even if assigned RPS numbers have the same dates in nomenclature, it still should return error

    3. If a contract has two PODs, both with RPS and different RPS numbers and they belong to the different billing group or same billing group but should be split into different invoices, billing run should not return error and calculate due date for each invoice separately based on different RPS numbers

    4. If a contract has two PODs, one with RPS and the other without it and they belong to the same billing group and are included in the same invoice, the billing run should calculate due date using RPS number in nomenclature

    5. If a contract has two PODs, one with RPS and the other without it and they belong to the different billing group or same billing group but should be split into different invoices, billing run should calculate due date for each invoice separately: for RPS pod based on RPS nomenclature and for non RPS pod based on contract.

  2. If “According to contract” is not selected, system should ignore date indicated in nomenclature and take due date from billing run.

Notes:

  • This change affects following billing run flows, only for product contract:

    • standard billing run

      • For volumes

      • Over time periodical (when level is POD)

      • Over time one time (when level is POD)

      • With electricity invoice

    • invoice correction
